info.title: Taicho External API
info.description:
Organization-scoped OAuth API for Taicho workspace, content, outreach, publishing, Cascade, Intelligence, webhooks, and durable AI operations.

### Authentication and tenant scope
Use Authorization Code with PKCE for user-facing integrations and Client Credentials for service principals. Request the exact API resource and minimum scopes registered in Developer integrations. Every access token is bound to one organization; resource identifiers are resolved only inside that organization and must not be supplied as a substitute tenant selector.

### Pagination and response identity
Collection operations declare their own pagination inputs (for example `limit`, `cursor`, or `page`) and response shape. Follow that operation instead of assuming a universal paging scheme. Successful JSON responses include request correlation and replay information in `meta`; preserve `X-Request-Id` when contacting support.

### Errors and safe retries
Errors use `application/problem+json` with an HTTP status, stable code, human-readable detail, and request ID. Mutations that declare `Idempotency-Key` require a unique 8–200 character key; reuse the same key only when retrying the same logical request.

### One-time media uploads
Create an upload handoff through the relevant publishing operation, then send bytes to its exact URL with `Authorization: Upload <token>`, the authorized `Content-Type`, and exact `Content-Length`. Upload tokens expire and can be consumed only once.

post.summary: Ingest an inbound reply or bounce

Nothing is sent — the external sender reads approved drafts.
